title: Model Checkpoint Conversion
summary: This module is dedicated to converting various model checkpoints from their original formats (e.g., TensorFlow, native PyTorch, Flax, NeMo) into compatible Hugging Face PyTorch models, ensuring seamless integration and functionality within the Transformers ecosystem.
